age.evidence: OIR mice were treated with L-serine (0.6 µg/g, i.p.) and vehicle (PBS) from P12 to P16. P17 OIR retinas from both eyes of one mouse (n = 8 mice for vehicle control and n = 8 for serine) were pooled and homogenized in RIPA buffer (#89900, Invitrogen) supplemented with 1% protease inhibitor and 0.1% phosphatase inhibitor.
P17 OIR retinas were collected from L-serine (0.6 µg/g, i.p.)- vs. vehicle control-treated mice from P12 to P16.

developmental_stage.evidence: Neonatal C57BL/6J mice (wild-type, Jackson Laboratory, #000664) with their nursing dam were exposed to 75% oxygen from postnatal day (P) 7 for five days (Figure S1A).
